cases.question: 2024年5月，家电品类的实收金额和有效订单数分别是多少？
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.amount - f.discount_amount), 2) AS 实收金额,
       COUNT(*) AS 有效订单数
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = '家电' AND f.order_status = '已支付'
  AND f.order_date >= '2024-05-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-05-31'

cases.question: 2024年上半年，华北地区的已取消订单有多少笔？
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 已取消订单数
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = '华北' AND f.order_status = '已取消' AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'

cases.question: 2024年6月，实收金额超过1000元的有效订单有多少笔？
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 订单数
FROM fact_order f
WHERE f.order_status = '已支付'
  AND (f.amount - f.discount_amount) > 1000
  AND f.order_date >= '2024-06-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'

cases.question: 2024年上半年，食品品类的销量合计是多少？
cases.sql:
SELECT SUM(f.quantity) AS 销量
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = '食品' AND f.order_status = '已支付' AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'

cases.question: 2024年上半年，各客户等级的有效订单数是多少？按订单数降序排列。
cases.sql:
SELECT c.customer_level AS 客户等级, COUNT(*) AS 有效订单数
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE f.order_status = '已支付' AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'
GROUP BY c.customer_level
ORDER BY 有效订单数 DESC, 客户等级

cases.question: 2024年上半年，各品牌的平均单笔实收金额是多少？按平均金额降序排列。
cases.sql:
SELECT p.brand AS 品牌,
       ROUND(AVG(f.amount - f.discount_amount), 2) AS 平均金额
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE f.order_status = '已支付' AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY 平均金额 DESC, 品牌

cases.question: 2024年上半年，各渠道的退款订单数是多少？

cases.question: 2024年上半年，下单次数超过5次的客户有哪些？列出客户姓名和订单数。
cases.sql:
SELECT c.customer_name AS 客户姓名, COUNT(*) AS 订单数
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE f.order_status = '已支付' AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY 订单数 DESC, 客户姓名

cases.question: 2024年上半年，每月的已退款订单数是多少？按月份升序排列。
cases.sql:
SELECT substr(f.order_date, 1, 7) AS 月份, COUNT(*) AS 退款订单数
FROM fact_order f
WHERE f.order_status = '已退款'
  AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'
GROUP BY substr(f.order_date, 1, 7)
ORDER BY 月份

cases.question: 2024年上半年，每周的实收金额是多少？按周升序排列。
cases.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', f.order_date) AS 年周,
       ROUND(SUM(f.amount - f.discount_amount), 2) AS 实收金额
FROM fact_order f
WHERE f.order_status = '已支付' AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%W', f.order_date)

cases.question: 2024年上半年，各地区的消费客户数是多少？按客户数降序排列。
cases.sql:
SELECT c.region AS 地区, COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_id) AS 消费客户数
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE f.order_status = '已支付' AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY 消费客户数 DESC, 地区

cases.question: 2024年上半年，各商品品类的商品成本合计是多少？按成本降序排列。

WHERE f.order_status = '已支付' AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'

cases.question: 2024年上半年，各客户等级的实收金额排名，列出等级、实收金额和排名。
cases.sql:
SELECT c.customer_level AS 客户等级,
       ROUND(SUM(f.amount - f.discount_amount), 2) AS 实收金额,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(f.amount - f.discount_amount) DESC) AS 排名
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE f.order_status = '已支付' AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'
GROUP BY c.customer_level
ORDER BY 排名, 客户等级

cases.question: 2024年上半年，各商品品类内部实收金额前2的品牌是哪些？列出品类、品牌、实收金额和品类内排名。
cases.sql:
WITH brand AS (
    SELECT p.category AS 品类, p.brand AS 品牌,
           SUM(f.amount - f.discount_amount) AS 实收金额
    FROM fact_order f
    JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE f.order_status = '已支付' AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'
    GROUP BY p.category, p.brand
)
SELECT 品类, 品牌, ROUND(实收金额, 2) AS 实收金额, 品类内排名
FROM (
    SELECT 品类, 品牌, 实收金额,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 品类
                              ORDER BY 实收金额 DESC) AS 品类内排名
    FROM brand
)
WHERE 品类内排名 <= 2
ORDER BY 品类, 品类内排名

cases.question: 2024年上半年，每月实收金额占上半年总实收金额的比例是多少？按比例降序排列。
cases.sql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT substr(f.order_date, 1, 7) AS 月份,
           SUM(f.amount - f.discount_amount) AS v
    FROM fact_order f
    WHERE f.order_status = '已支付'
      AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'
    GROUP BY substr(f.order_date, 1, 7)
)
SELECT 月份,
       ROUND(v, 2) AS 实收金额,
       ROUND(v * 1.0 / SUM(v) OVER (), 4) AS 占比
FROM m
ORDER BY 占比 DESC, 月份

cases.question: 2024年上半年，实收金额低于全部客户平均消费金额的客户有哪些？列出客户姓名和实收金额。
cases.sql:
WITH cust AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name,
           SUM(f.amount - f.discount_amount) AS 实收金额
    FROM fact_order f
    JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE f.order_status = '已支付'
      AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
)
SELECT customer_name AS 客户姓名, ROUND(实收金额, 2) AS 实收金额
FROM cust
WHERE 实收金额 < (SELECT AVG(实收金额) FROM cust)

cases.question: 2024年上半年，实收金额高于全部品类平均实收金额的品类有哪些？列出品类和实收金额。
cases.sql:
WITH cat AS (
    SELECT p.category AS 品类,
           SUM(f.amount - f.discount_amount) AS 实收金额
    FROM fact_order f
    JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE f.order_status = '已支付'
      AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'
    GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT 品类, ROUND(实收金额, 2) AS 实收金额
FROM cat
WHERE 实收金额 > (SELECT AVG(实收金额) FROM cat)

cases.question: 2024年上半年，实收金额不低于全部客户平均消费金额1.2倍的客户有哪些？列出客户姓名和实收金额。
cases.sql:
WITH cust AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name,
           SUM(f.amount - f.discount_amount) AS 实收金额
    FROM fact_order f
    JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE f.order_status = '已支付'
      AND f.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND f.order_date <= '2024-06-30'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
)
SELECT customer_name AS 客户姓名, ROUND(实收金额, 2) AS 实收金额
FROM cust
WHERE 实收金额 >= (SELECT AVG(实收金额) * 1.2 FROM cust)
